title: SecurityScanResult
description: Common envelope for the three real, dependency-free scan kinds security-scan.mjs performs: secret-scan (regex-based, no vendored tool), dependency-audit (shells out to the project's OWN npm/pnpm/yarn audit — detect-and-invoke, not vendored), and sbom (generated from the lockfile already on disk). `kind` distinguishes them; `available` is false when the underlying tool/lockfile isn't present, reported explicitly rather than silently skipped.
